inputs.name: mailerFiles.name
inputs.description: A string name used to derive the mailer class name and its source and test filenames. The implementation applies PascalCase and kebab-case conversions when building those names.

inputs.name: helperFiles.name
inputs.description: A string name used to derive the helper function name and source and test filenames. The implementation applies camelCase and kebab-case conversions when building those names.

inputs.name: concernFiles.name
inputs.description: A string name used to derive the concern function name and filenames. The implementation uses PascalCase for the function suffix and kebab-case for the file name.

inputs.name: channelFiles.name
inputs.description: A string name used to derive the channel class name and source and test filenames. The implementation applies PascalCase and kebab-case conversions when building those names.

inputs.name: formFiles.name
inputs.description: A string name used to derive the form class name and source and test filenames. The implementation applies PascalCase and kebab-case conversions when building those names.

inputs.name: initializerFiles.name
inputs.description: A string name used to derive the initializer function name and filenames. The implementation uses PascalCase for the function suffix and kebab-case for the file name.

inputs.name: configFiles.name
inputs.description: A string name used to derive the config export name and filenames. The implementation applies camelCase and kebab-case conversions when building those names.

inputs.name: middlewareFiles.name
inputs.description: A string name used to derive the middleware class name and source and test filenames. The implementation applies PascalCase and kebab-case conversions when building those names.

inputs.name: resourceFiles.name
inputs.description: A string resource name passed to the model, controller, policy, serializer, API, view and E2E generators. This wrapper fixes the parsed field to title:string and the adapter to sqlite.

outputs.name: mailerFiles
outputs.description: The file plans for the named mailer: a message interface and class under src/mailers, plus a test under test/mailers. Each plan has a repository-relative path and file contents.

outputs.name: helperFiles
outputs.description: The file plans for a helper that trims display text and its test. The helper name and file paths are derived from the input name.

outputs.name: concernFiles
outputs.description: The file plans for a concern function that copies its input and adds the kebab-cased concern name, plus its test. The source path uses the generated function name.

outputs.name: channelFiles
outputs.description: The file plans for a channel class and its test. The class counts subscriptions and returns broadcast payloads unchanged.

outputs.name: formFiles
outputs.description: The file plans for a form class and its test. The class reports an error when values are empty and returns a shallow copy as its payload.

outputs.name: initializerFiles
outputs.description: The file plans for an initializer function and its test. The function returns the enabled setting, defaulting to true when it is absent.

outputs.name: configFiles
outputs.description: The file plans for an empty config module and its test. The module starts with no settings and uses the input name with a Config suffix.

outputs.name: middlewareFiles
outputs.description: The file plans for a middleware class and its test. Its handle method returns the incoming request unchanged.

outputs.name: resourceFiles
outputs.description: The returned file plans combine adapter types, model, controller, policy, serializer, API, view and E2E generators for the resource name. This wrapper parses the fixed field title:string and selects the sqlite adapter.
